title: ICAO Annex 17 — Aviation Security: Misuse of Security Procedures and Failure to Protect Passengers
category: International Aviation / Human Rights / Treaty Law

incident.location: Santiago International Airport (SCL), aboard aircraft LA8159, Chile

allegation_summary: ICAO Annex 17 establishes the international framework for aviation security, with the primary objective of safeguarding passengers, crew, ground personnel, and the general public against acts of unlawful interference (Article 2.1.1). In this incident, LATAM and Chilean authorities misused security procedures to remove a passenger who posed no security threat: (a) the removal was executed under the guise of security (crew alleging 'conduct' issues) when CCTV later proved no threat existed; (b) the state failed to ensure that security measures 'take into account the safety, regularity and efficiency of flights' (Art. 3.1.1) — instead, the misuse of security procedures caused the very disruption (20-minute delay) that the DGAC then used to justify removal; (c) the state failed in its duty under Article 5.2.1 to 'take appropriate measures for the safety of passengers and crew' by not protecting the passenger from the arbitrary enforcement action.

articles.article_text: Each Contracting State shall have as its primary objective the safety of passengers, crew, ground personnel and the general public in all matters related to safeguarding against acts of unlawful interference with civil aviation.

articles.article_text: Each Contracting State shall establish and implement a written national civil aviation security programme to safeguard civil aviation operations against acts of unlawful interference, through regulations, practices and procedures which take into account the safety, regularity and efficiency of flights.

articles.article_text: Each Contracting State shall take appropriate measures for the safety of passengers and crew of an aircraft, which is subjected to an act of unlawful interference, while on the ground in the territory of the Contracting State, until their journey can be continued.
